app.name: Summo
app.tagline: Runs on your machine. Nothing leaves it.

nav.label: Navigation
nav.shrink_hint: Shrink while you are in the meeting

record.idle: Press record to start. Everything runs on your machine.
record.translate_hint: Each finished line is translated and shown under the original.
record.translate_needs_system: Translation is on but only the microphone is captured — turn on System to translate what is playing.

import.title: Import a recording
import.hint: An audio or video file. The audio is extracted and transcribed on your machine.
import.no_dialog: Could not open a file dialog — paste a path below instead.
import.formats: mp3 · m4a · wav · mp4 · mkv · webm

meeting.no_audio: This meeting's audio has been pruned. The transcript is complete.
meeting.no_summary_yet: No summary for this meeting yet.

draft.heading: Summary drafted by the agent
draft.chat_placeholder: Ask the agent to change the whole summary…
draft.revise_placeholder: shorter, drop the client's name, add dates…
draft.select_hint: Select a passage to change just that part, or write below to change the whole thing.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.heading: To do
tasks.no_plan: The agent has not planned this one yet.
tasks.agent_empty_head: The agent has nothing to do. Give it work by writing

chat.title: Ask
chat.question: Question
chat.placeholder: What did Ngọc say about the budget?
chat.heading: Ask the vault
chat.intro: Ask anything that was said in a meeting.
chat.intro_2: Every answer names the meeting it came from.

library.title: Library
library.heading: Your meetings
library.vault_hint: Everything lives in ~/.summo/vault — open it in Obsidian, grep it, back it up however you like.

people.title: People
people.forget_note: Older transcripts keep the name. Summo will stop recognising this voice.
people.empty: Nobody yet. Record a meeting, then name a voice — Summo recognises it next time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_hint: Add a language by dropping a JSON file into ~/.summo/locales/
settings.key_missing: Set {name} (or SUMMO_API_KEY) before using this. Transcript text will be sent to this provider.
settings.key_needed: Needs SUMMO_API_KEY. Transcript text will be sent.
settings.local_only: Runs on your machine. Nothing leaves it.
settings.sent_here: Transcript text is sent here. Audio never is.
settings.local_only_comma: Runs on your machine, nothing leaves it.
settings.llm_hint_tail: . Only summaries, translation and questions use a language model — and you choose where it runs.
settings.key_not_stored: The key is not stored in the settings file — if it were, it would follow into backups and sync.
settings.key_found: {name} is set. Transcript text will be sent to this provider.
settings.mt_hint: Translation can use a small model of its own. A 1B translation model is better at translating than a general 8B one, runs on your CPU, and costs nothing per line — so translation keeps working even with no API key at all.
settings.mt_enable: Use a separate model for translation
settings.mt_run: Serve it with `llama-server -m milmmt-46-1b.gguf --port 8080`, or from Ollama. About 800 MB on disk.
settings.mt_pull: Install it once with `summo pull small100` — 611 MB, and nothing else to run. `milmmt-46-1b` is more accurate at 806 MB.

setup.title: Welcome to Summo
setup.promise: Speech recognition and speaker attribution run entirely on your machine. Audio never leaves it.
setup.no_models: Could not reach the model list. Check the network, or run `summo pull` if you already have the files.
setup.upstream_note: Summo does not distribute this model. The files come straight from whoever published them, under their own licence.
setup.why_ffmpeg: needed to import audio or video files you already have.
setup.why_llm: needed for summaries, translation and asking questions. Recording does not use it.
setup.why_models: needed before anything can be recorded.

tour.title: Quick tour
tour.record_body: Press record to start a meeting, or switch to Upload if you already have a recording.
tour.summary_body: When the meeting ends the agent writes a summary into the note and highlights the part waiting on you. Edit it, or tell the agent what to change, then confirm.
tour.tasks_title: Tasks come out of the meeting
tour.tasks_body: Tasks assigned to a person go on the people board. Tasks assigned to @agent are run by the agent, one logged step at a time.
tour.ask_title: Ask about anything that was said
tour.ask_body: Ask searches every meeting and answers with timestamps you can click.

about.title: About Summo
about.company_line: AI solutions to empower humanity's potential
about.local_promise: Speech recognition and speaker attribution run entirely on your machine. Audio never leaves it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.pick: Pick a note, or make one.
notes.placeholder:
The first line is the title.

Write anything. For a task, write `- [ ] @name …`.

agenda.title: Calendar
agenda.hint: Read from .ics files you add. Summo never records on a schedule — this only helps title a meeting note.
agenda.empty: No calendars yet. Export an .ics from Google Calendar or Fastmail and add it here.

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: Nothing said yet. Leave a note, ask a question, or answer the agent.

errors.comment.empty: A comment needs something in it.
errors.translation.no_language: That translation file does not say what language it is in.
errors.translation.bad_language: That is not a language code.
errors.translate.no_target: Pick a language to translate into.
errors.import.is_directory: That is a folder — pick one file at a time.
errors.import.no_audio: That file has no audio in it.
errors.calendar.no_events: That file has no events in it — is it really an .ics?
errors.audio.not_mono: The audio has to be single-channel mono.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Each one is a folder of Markdown in your vault.
agents.pick: Choose an agent to see what it was told.
agents.file_hint: This is the file itself. The YAML at the top is settings; everything under it is what the agent is told it is for.
agents.tools_hint: What it can actually call, after the shared rules are applied.
agents.dangling: {from} can hand work to “{to}”, but no agent by that name exists.

empty.tasks_hint: Tasks come from the checkboxes in your meeting notes. Write “- [ ] @ngoc settle the spec” in one and it appears here.
empty.chat_hint: Answers come from your own transcripts, with the meeting and timestamp they came from.
empty.agenda_hint: Export an .ics from Google Calendar or Fastmail and add it above. Summo never records on its own — it only uses this to name a meeting.
